core: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
qualifier: sodium and calcium flux, outside cardiac action potential phases
name: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
rationale: All members regulate (mostly inhibit) sodium, calcium or potassium movement across the plasma membrane; unlike the confusables, the theme lacks cardiac action-potential phases and two-pore/Kir potassium channels and instead adds sodium import and transport control.

qualifier: Sema3A and Sema4D repulsion and growth-cone collapse
name: Semaphorin-plexin repulsive signaling via Sema3A and Sema4D
rationale: Every member is semaphorin-plexin signaling (Sema3A via CRMPs, PAK and integrin inhibition; Sema4D via RND1 and cell-migration inhibition), distinguishing it from netrin/ephrin axon guidance and Rho-GPCR confusables.

qualifier: UV-induced gene expression rather than excision repair
name: UV-induced gene expression response
rationale: All three members are the cellular response to UV light (up- and down-regulated UV gene sets and UV-B response), lacking the nucleotide excision repair and pyrimidine-dimer repair that define the DNA-repair confusable.

qualifier: endosomal recycling, internalization and clustering
name: Postsynaptic AMPA receptor trafficking, recycling and clustering
rationale: Members concern placing and maintaining AMPA-type glutamate receptors at the postsynaptic membrane (clustering, diffusion trapping, endosome-to-membrane transport, internalization, ARF signaling, postsynaptic actin) and the resulting excitatory transmission, whereas confusables emphasize NMDA/kainate receptor activation and LTP/LTD signaling.

qualifier: 2-AG and anandamide turnover with retrograde lipid signaling
name: Endocannabinoid synthesis, degradation and retrograde signaling
rationale: All members cover endocannabinoid lipids: diacylglycerol/monoacylglycerol lipase turnover of 2-AG to arachidonate, N-acylethanolamine (anandamide) metabolism and retrograde synaptic lipid signaling, distinct from the prostanoid, leukotriene and resolvin eicosanoid confusables.

qualifier: control of leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation
name: Inflammatory chemokine output and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion control
rationale: Members combine myeloid proinflammatory chemokine/cytokine programs with (mostly negative) regulation of IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1 and adhesion-molecule production, leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and extravasation, whereas confusables center on monocyte chemotaxis/activation or lymphocyte TNF/IL-23 output.

core: Viral genome replication and gene expression in host cells
qualifier: retroviral reverse transcription and integration; host control of viral transcription
name: Viral genome replication, gene expression and retroviral integration
rationale: Members span intracellular viral replication of HIV, influenza, RSV, coronaviruses and HCMV (reverse transcription, integration, viral RNA synthesis, viral translation and host modulation of viral transcription), lacking the entry, assembly and protein-maturation steps that dominate the confusables.

qualifier: securin and cyclin B degradation and direct APC/C inhibition
name: APC/C-Cdc20 degradation of securin and cyclin B
rationale: All three members concern APC/C:Cdc20 at anaphase onset, its degradation of securin and cyclin B and its direct inhibition, distinct from confusables about APC/C:Cdh1, cyclin A, Nek2A, Emi1 or APC/C phosphorylation.

qualifier: negative regulation, including hepatocyte and activation-induced T cell death
name: Fas-mediated extrinsic apoptosis and its negative regulation
rationale: All members concern FasL/CD95-triggered extrinsic apoptosis (BID activation, activation-induced T cell death) and its inhibition, including protection of hepatocytes, unlike the TRAIL, caspase-8/c-FLIP and T cell signaling confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation of CD4 T cell activation by myeloid dendritic cells
name: Dendritic cell-driven CD4 T cell activation and proliferation
rationale: The three members link myeloid dendritic cell activation, TCR-MHC contact on antigen-presenting cells and CD4 alpha-beta T cell proliferation, the positive side of APC-T cell interaction, whereas confusables describe negative regulation of T cells, regulatory T cell differentiation or surface signatures.

core: Ketone body and fatty acid oxidation metabolism
qualifier: carnitine shuttle and transport feeding ketogenesis
name: Ketogenesis, ketolysis and carnitine-dependent fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members cover ketone body synthesis and utilization together with carnitine transport and shuttle and the regulation of fatty acid beta-oxidation, distinguished from confusables that hold individual beta-oxidation steps or medium-chain/peroxisomal fatty acid metabolism without ketone bodies.

qualifier: ATR-mediated intra-S replication stress checkpoint
name: DNA replication initiation control and intra-S replication checkpoint
rationale: Members regulate DNA replication initiation and progression together with ATR activation, intra-S and replication checkpoints and recombination-intermediate resolution, whereas confusables hold E2F/G1-S transcription, pre-replicative complex assembly or G2/M events.

qualifier: dense core vesicle release and opioid G protein-coupled receptor signaling
name: Neuropeptide release and opioid G protein-coupled receptor signaling
rationale: All members cover neuropeptide transmission from presynaptic dense core vesicle exocytosis through G protein activation by opioid and other neuropeptide receptors, whereas confusables are behavioral drug, stress and sleep/orexin responses.

qualifier: p53 transcription of death genes and negative control of DNA damage-induced apoptosis
name: p53 transcriptional control of DNA damage-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members concern p53 transcription of apoptotic genes (death receptors, caspases, cytochrome c release, PUMA) and the regulation, including negative regulation, of DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis, while confusables center on p53 abundance, positive regulation or NOXA/BH3-only steps.

qualifier: caspase-4 and caspase-5
name: Caspase-4/5 noncanonical inflammasome assembly and substrate cleavage
rationale: All four members are assembly and substrate cleavage of the caspase-4 and caspase-5 inflammasomes, distinct from AIM2, NLRP1/3 and IPAF inflammasomes or pyroptosis and IL-1/IL-18 output in the confusables.

core: Cytoplasmic mRNA stability and translation control
qualifier: AU-rich element binding proteins, decapping and 3'-UTR-mediated decay
name: ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members are RNA-binding proteins (TTP, AUF1, BRF1, KSRP, HuR, IGF2BPs) and pathways that stabilize, decap, degrade or translationally silence mRNAs via 3'-UTR elements, unlike confusables on stress granules, nuclear mRNA processing/export or deadenylation.

qualifier: translational fidelity, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough
name: tRNA maturation, aminoacylation and translational fidelity
rationale: Members cover nuclear tRNA processing and splicing, anticodon modifications, cytosolic and mitochondrial aminoacylation, selenocysteine synthesis and translational fidelity/readthrough, distinguishing them from confusables that add rRNA/mRNA modification, protein modifications or mitochondrial gene expression.

qualifier: positive regulation of lamellipodia and pseudopodia
name: Positive regulation of leading-edge lamellipodial protrusion
rationale: All three members promote protrusive structures and protein localization at the cell leading edge, while confusables are Rho GTPase cycles, negative regulation of protrusion and adhesion, or actin severing and capping.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation; intramembranous ossification
name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and intramembranous bone formation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and development and the bone they form (direct ossification, cranial sutures, trabeculae, tendon), distinguished from confusables centered on Wnt/mesenchymal stem cell control or RUNX2 and cartilage/joint morphogenesis.

qualifier: protein lipoylation, lysine catabolism and glycine cleavage
name: Lipoate-dependent 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and lysine catabolism
rationale: Members share lipoylated DLD-containing multienzyme complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, glycine cleavage) with protein lipoylation and lysine catabolism to glutaryl-CoA, whereas confusables cover GABA metabolism, the TCA cycle proper, BCKDH/MSUD or coenzyme A synthesis.

qualifier: threonine, alanine and glyoxylate metabolism feeding creatine synthesis and gluconeogenesis
name: Glycine-linked amino acid metabolism, creatine synthesis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members link threonine, alanine and glyoxylate catabolism to glycine production, glycine use in creatine/phosphocreatine synthesis and carbon flow through oxaloacetate to gluconeogenesis; confusables lack creatine and instead hold carnitine/choline, glutamate/aspartate or glycine conjugation.

qualifier: sympathoadrenal lineage and catecholamine biosynthesis via RET/GDNF and endothelin signaling
name: Autonomic neural crest development and catecholamine biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover neural crest-derived enteric, sympathetic and adrenal development driven by RET/GDNF and endothelin signaling together with noradrenergic neuron development and catecholamine synthesis, while confusables center on gastrointestinal motility or endothelin control of blood pressure.

qualifier: NOD1/NOD2 peptidoglycan sensing and the IPAF inflammasome
name: NOD-like receptor detection of bacteria and peptidoglycan
rationale: Members are NLR-mediated bacterial sensing (NOD1/NOD2 responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide, IPAF inflammasome) with the resulting antibacterial, microbiota and dendritic cell presentation responses, distinct from TLR/LPS, downstream NF-kB or caspase-1/4/5 inflammasome confusables.

qualifier: sorting to lysosomes and secretion
name: Trans-Golgi network vesicle sorting to lysosomes and secretion
rationale: All members concern vesicle formation and sorting at the trans-Golgi network toward lysosomes or secretion, plus retrograde transport into the TGN, whereas confusables emphasize specialized granule biogenesis, endosome-to-Golgi retrieval or intra-Golgi traffic.

qualifier: Th1 and regulatory T cell fates, restraint of Th17
name: CD4 T cell differentiation toward Th1 and Treg fates
rationale: Members promote Th1 and FOXP3 regulatory T cell differentiation and restrain Th17 commitment, all CD4 lineage choices, whereas confusables describe negative regulation of T cell activation and cytokines or Th1 effector cytokine output.
